name: sj-svalbard-transfer-pricing
description: Apply ordinary Svalbard related-party pricing and compliance rules for tax year 2026. Covers the imported arm's-length adjustment rule, controlled transaction and balance reporting, ownership/control definitions, small-transaction relief, separate group-size documentation relief, information-exchange exceptions, evidence content and retention. Explains return filing, the forty-five-day response deadline, penalties and the distinction between local tax allocation and international treaty relief. Includes two reproducible examples showing an ordinary price correction and the effect of a correction on the company higher-rate slice. Use for Svalbard intercompany services, related-party loans, group transactions, documentation and mainland allocations. Jan Mayen and specialist multinational regimes are excluded. This is a source-cited draft awaiting professional review.
